composition.serve_who: This sheet (108-01-520-001 rev B, "BILGE & FIRE SYSTEM SCHEMATIC") is the master P&ID for the vessel's combined bilge and fire main system, serving both the 520-bilge-system card and the individual pump/valve equipment nodes it enumerates: 520-main-bilge-pump, 520-fire-pump, 520-diesel-fire-pump, 520-aux-bilge-pumps, 520-bilge-valves, 520-feit-bilge-pump, 520-whale-pumps, 520-vega-bilge-level-sensors. Evidence: title block names the system; deck plan labels pump stations (MAIN BILGE PUMP, ELECTRIC FIRE PUMP, DIESEL BACKUP BILGE PUMP, AUX BILGE PUMPS at engine room and mast) matching the BOM item tags 001-025; sump boxes (Lazarette, Midship, Engine Room, Mast Area, ESS Enclosure, Sail Locker) all feed the same bilge main; fire hydrants/hose stations and tender garage sprinkler all feed the same fire main. The authoritative Operating Modes doc supplies the four named lineups (Normal, Aux-bilge-overboard/to-storage, Fire backup, Bilge backup) which are reconciled below against the walked topology.

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: This is the system-card node for the combined bilge & fire schematic — the sheet's own title and the operating-modes doc describe system-level lineups (not single-pump behaviour) that belong here.

functions.label: Normal operation — Main Bilge // Main Fire
functions.what_it_does: Main Bilge Pump (electric, 001) draws from any of the five sumps (Lazarette, Midship, Engine Room, Mast Area, Sail Locker) via their strum boxes and NC isolation valves — only the valve(s) for the flooded sump are opened — and discharges overboard via the anti-siphon manifold, with a breather line running into the STBD E-R vent box. In parallel, the Electric Fire Pump (024) and Diesel Fire Pump (002) draw seawater via the seawater strainer and pressurise the fire line running in the port sheer to the fire hydrant/hose stations and the tender garage sprinkler head.

flow_scenarios.path: flooded sump -> strum box -> open NC branch valve for that sump -> main bilge line (metallic) -> Main Bilge Pump (001) -> anti-siphon manifold (breather to STBD E-R vent box) -> overboard; all OTHER sump branch valves remain NC/closed

seawater pickup -> seawater strainer (005) -> Electric Fire Pump (024) or Diesel Fire Pump (002) -> fire line in port sheer -> fire hydrant valves (018) / hose stations (019/020) and tender garage sprinkler head (022)

key_components: NC sump isolation valves (open only the relevant one)
anti-siphon manifold with breather to STBD E-R vent box
seawater strainer upstream of fire pumps
functions.dry_data: Blue = main bilge line (metallic); Red = main fire line (metallic) per pipe legend.

functions.label: Auxiliary bilge operation — aux pump overboard (where regulations allow)
functions.what_it_does: E-R Aux Bilge Pump (003-02) and Mast Aux Bilge Pump (003-01) each draw from their local sump suction manifold and discharge through the oily bilge filter (004) then via flex suction hose connections either overboard through the FWD deck locker drain (min. 800mm above DWL) or to the portable oil storage tank.

flow_scenarios.path: Engine Room Sump / Mast Area Sump -> aux bilge pump suction manifold -> E-R Aux Bilge Pump (003-02) or Mast Aux Bilge Pump (003-01) -> oily bilge filter (004) -> flex suction hose connection -> FWD deck locker drain, min. 800mm above DWL -> overboard

key_components: oily bilge filter inline before discharge
flex suction hose connections at each discharge option
functions.dry_data: Purple line = aux bilge line (PVC/flex) per pipe legend; overboard route only permitted 'when regulations allow' per operating-modes doc.

functions.label: Auxiliary bilge operation — aux pump to portable storage containers
functions.what_it_does: Same two aux bilge pumps, same suction and oily-bilge-filter path, but routed via flex suction hose connection to a portable oil storage tank instead of overboard; the FWD deck locker drain route remains available for reference.

flow_scenarios.path: Engine Room Sump / Mast Area Sump -> aux suction manifold -> aux bilge pump (003-01/003-02) -> oily bilge filter (004) -> flex suction hose connection -> portable oil storage tank (via Gardena-type tap connector, 021)

key_components: Gardena-type tap connector to portable tank
functions.dry_data: Purple line path; alternate destination selected by which flex hose is connected, not by a fixed valve per sheet.

functions.label: Emergency operation — fire backup (diesel fire pump only)
functions.what_it_does: With the electric fire pump marked NOT OPERATIONAL, the Diesel Fire Pump (002) alone draws seawater via the seawater strainer and supplies both fore and aft sections of the fire line in the port sheer for hydrant/hose use. A priming line from the fresh water supply (ref dwg 108-01-510-001) is used to prime the diesel pump before start.

flow_scenarios.path: priming line from fresh water supply (ref 108-01-510-001) -> Diesel Fire Pump (002) primed -> seawater pickup -> seawater strainer -> Diesel Fire Pump discharge -> fire line port sheer (fore + aft) -> hydrants/hose stations

key_components: priming line valve (NC) from fresh water supply
functions.dry_data: Orange line = emergency fire backup path per operating-modes doc; electric fire pump shown with red X (not operational) in this mode.
functions.sheet_region: aft area near diesel fire pump station, frames K-J

functions.label: Emergency operation — bilge backup
functions.what_it_does: With the Main Bilge Pump marked NOT OPERATIONAL, the Diesel Fire Pump (driven via its priming line) and the STBD Genset's raw water pump serve as backup bilge suction: sumps drain via the same NC branch valves (only the flooded sump's valve opened) to the anti-siphon manifold and overboard, while the raw water pump draws additionally from the seachest supply (ref dwg 108-01-515-003) and discharges overboard via the exhaust water separator (ref dwg 108-01-515-001).

flow_scenarios.path: flooded sump -> strum box -> open NC branch valve -> Diesel Fire Pump (via priming line) -> anti-siphon manifold (breather to STBD E-R vent box) -> overboard
seachest supply (ref 108-01-515-003) -> STBD Genset raw water pump -> exhaust water separator (ref 108-01-515-001) -> overboard

key_components: NC sump branch valves (open only relevant one)
